# Security policy

Please do not open a public issue for a weakness that could hurt a shop or its customers. Report it privately: this
repository's **Security** tab › **Report a vulnerability**
([github.com/amir-aghajani/amo-bot/security/advisories/new](https://github.com/amir-aghajani/amo-bot/security/advisories/new)).

What to include, what is in scope and how a shop is kept safe:
[the project's security page](https://github.com/amir-aghajani/amo-bot/blob/main/docs/Security.md).
